summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across node1 (primary, writable), node2, and node3 (standbys) on RHEL7, secured with a self-signed cluster CA. Replication connections are TLS-only (hostssl) and require a client certificate issued by that CA (clientcert=verify-full), verified functionally and after a rolling restart of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Installed PGDG PostgreSQL 15 repo on all nodes (disabled dead EOL pgdg12/13/14 repos causing 410 errors)
Installed EPEL (via archived mirror) to satisfy libzstd dependency, then installed postgresql15-server/postgresql15 on node1, node2, node3
Generated a dedicated cluster CA (ca.key/ca.crt) on node1 under /etc/pg-ca
Issued per-node server certs (CN=nodeX, SAN=DNS+IP) for node1/node2/node3 and a client cert (CN=replicator) signed by the CA
Distributed CA cert, server certs, and client cert to node2/node3 over cluster SSH; installed them under postgres's PGDATA and ~/.postgresql
initdb'd node1 as primary with scram-sha-256 auth; configured ssl=on with the CA-issued cert/key and wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, max_replication_slots, hot_standby

Configured pg_hba.conf on all nodes: hostssl replication for 'replicator' from each node IP with cert clientcert=verify-full, explicit hostnossl reject rule, and scram-sha-256 for local admin over TLS loopback
Created the 'replicator' REPLICATION role (cert auth only, no password)
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Ran pg_basebackup with -R over sslmode=verify-full using the replicator client cert to bootstrap node2 and node3 as standbys, generating standby.signal and primary_conninfo with sslmode=verify-full
Started/enabled postgresql-15 on node2/node3, confirmed streaming state and SSL=true on the primary
Verified rejection of a replication connection missing a valid client certificate (pg_hba no-match/FATAL)
Verified end-to-end write on primary replicates to both standbys
Captured pre-restart boot_id and PostgreSQL/replication health baseline on all nodes
Rebooted node3, then node2, then node1 (primary) one at a time via 'sudo reboot' backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect; polled each until reachable
Confirmed boot_id changed on each node post-restart (proof of actual restart, not just service restart)

Confirmed postgresql-15 active and pg_is_in_recovery()/data intact after each restart, and re-verified full streaming+SSL replication and a fresh write propagated to all nodes after the primary's restart

evidence.summary: pg_basebackup with -R bootstrapped standbys; both show pg_is_in_recovery=t and primary's pg_stat_replication lists both walreceivers streaming
select pg_is_in_recovery() returns false on node1 before and after restart

evidence.requirement: Replication traffic carried over TLS using a cluster-created CA
evidence.summary: CA generated on node1 (/etc/pg-ca), server/client certs issued from it; pg_stat_ssl.ssl=t for both walreceiver connections on the primary

evidence.requirement: Only peers with a CA-issued client cert accepted for replication
evidence.summary: pg_hba.conf restricts hostssl replication to cert clientcert=verify-full; a connection attempt without the client cert (env unset) from node2 is rejected with 'no pg_hba.conf entry ... SSL encryption'
Rows inserted on node1 (primary) appear identically on node2 and node3, both before and after the restart cycle

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 3dba43a5...; reboot ack returned; boot_id changed to 2e2f145d...; postgresql-15 active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, repl_test intact, walreceiver from .12 streaming again on primary

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 738d0aac...; reboot ack returned; boot_id changed to 139c5539...; postgresql-15 active, pg_is_in_recovery=t, repl_test intact, both standbys streaming again on primary

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state incl. quorum/membership
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 2fc81aed...; standbys confirmed streaming before restart (independent recovery path preserved); reboot ack returned; boot_id changed to cafc4b0e...; postgresql-15 active, pg_is_in_recovery=f (writable primary), both walreceivers reconnected over SSL, new write replicated to both standbys
